preconditions.description: The length of the array a is between 3 and 5000.

postconditions.expression: The array a is guessed correctly.
postconditions.description: The output should be in the format '! a1 a2 ... an' where a1, a2, ..., an are the elements of the array a.

invariants.expression: The number of requests made is at most n.
invariants.description: The program can make at most n requests to guess the array.
